scripts.//test: test:unit is offline and fast; test:schema needs pglite; test:e2e talks to the live FP sandbox. `test` runs the two that need no network.
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:schema
scripts.test:unit: bun test tests/unit.test.ts tests/sandbox-auth.test.ts tests/kyc-prefill.test.ts && bun test tests/kyc-flow.test.ts && bun test tests/email-login.test.ts && bun test tests/otp-context.test.ts && bun test tests/redemption-settle.test.ts
scripts.//e2e: Live end-to-end run against the FP ONDC sandbox and the configured database. Creates real objects; never point it at production.
scripts.//prisma: Every Prisma command runs through `bunx --bun` so the CLI uses the Bun runtime (and loads .env) instead of falling back to Node.
scripts.//migrate: migrate:dev creates migrations locally. Deploys run migrate:deploy only — never migrate:dev.
scripts.//seed-refresh: Re-captures the FP sandbox scheme catalogue that the seed loads. Needs FP_* credentials and network access; the seed itself needs neither.
scripts.//docs: Regenerates SCHEMA.md from prisma/schema.prisma. Run after any schema change.
